note: DRIBL match centre API (fsa.dribl.com), 2026 season, SL1 + SL2 all grades. Extracted with extract_browser.js.
DRIBL does not record positions or formations for these leagues (1 player of ~530 sampled). Only GK vs outfield is known.
Starters: sub-off minute (or red card) else match length. Subs: match length minus sub-on minute. Bench unused: 0.

Under 18 leagues almost never record sub minutes. Subs without a recorded minute are assumed on at 70'. Starters on a team-side that logged no subs are assumed to play the full match. Flagged in minutes_estimated / minutes_est_apps.
From the lineup goals list. Own goals excluded from 'goals'; penalties split out. Non-pen goals per 90 = goals_open_play / minutes * 90.
Reconstructed from the match-centre goal timeline. equaliser = level after; go_ahead = takes lead; winner = go-ahead goal after which the team never fell level, in a match it won; late = 75'+.
Goals for/against while the player was on (using the minute window). gd_on_pitch_vs_team subtracts the team's regular-season GD per match.
Per-match 3-2-1 votes recorded in DRIBL (likely best-on-ground). Not shown publicly. ~249 of 294 matches have votes.
DRIBL flag: player borrowed from another team in the club for that match. Direct 'playing up/down' signal.
sen/res/u18 minutes summed across all the player's teams. hidden_gem = not a senior-grade row and zero senior minutes all season.

Players with >= 450 minutes and >= 5 apps. Rates ending in _adj are shrunk toward the league mean (prior = 450 minutes / 5 apps) so short bursts don't top the list. z-scores within league. Outfield weights: {'npg_per90_adj': 0.35, 'votes_per_app_adj': 0.25, 'gd_on_pitch_vs_team': 0.2, 'team_goal_share_pct': 0.1, 'minutes_share_pct': 0.1}. GK weights: {'ga_abs_neg': 0.25, 'ga_rel_neg': 0.15, 'clean_sheet_pct': 0.3, 'votes_per_app_adj': 0.2, 'minutes_share_pct': 0.1} (ga_abs_neg = -GA/90 on pitch, ga_rel_neg = -(GA/90 on pitch minus team GA/match)). gem_score = scout_score + 0.3 if hidden_gem + 0.15 if U18 player.
Regular-season ladders only. opp_top_half = opponent finished in the top half of its league.
Regular season only, only when the player started >= 3 and missed >= 3. Small samples: treat as a flag, not evidence.
Assists, shots, xG, passes, tackles, positions, age/DOB, transfer status. Data is entered by club volunteers and can contain attribution errors.
date_local is Australia/Adelaide. Raw API dates are UTC.
